{% extends "!base.html" %} {# Cloudflare declines prefetch requests on route-based static hosting. The visible brand loads normally; speculative logo requests add only failures. #} {% block logo_prefetch_links %}{% endblock logo_prefetch_links %} {# The theme declares its colour and font variables in a style element on every page. They are the same on every page of a root, so the build writes them once to cadrumo-theme-variables.css, linked after every other stylesheet. #} {% block theme_styles %}{% endblock theme_styles %} {# This root's own path inside the served site, empty when the root IS the site. The site carries one search index for every language, at the apex above the language roots, so the search controller needs to know how far back the apex is and which root a shared result must be opened inside. It is declared here, in the head of every page, because the search page does not extend this project's page template and so carries none of the header this would otherwise ride on. The theme already declares the path from a page to its own root as data-content_root on ; this is the one further fact. #} {% block extrahead %} {{ super() }} {% endblock extrahead %} {# Sphinx loads its own interface strings from _static/translations.js and adds that script only for a language whose strings it ships. The one compile has no one language, so the tag is written here instead, once per script and for no script but the one it follows (dev.docs.translations_js). The loop is the theme's own; a build that is not that compile gets the empty string back and writes the bytes it writes today. #} {% block regular_scripts %}{% for path in script_files -%} {{ js_tag(path) }}{{ cadrumo_translations_js_tag(path.filename) }} {% endfor -%}{% endblock regular_scripts %}
